description: This file defines the interface and data structures for an AudioPlayer class in a multimedia system. It includes class declarations, enums for different audio types, source types, connection statuses, and playback modes, as well as method signatures for controlling audio playback, pipeline management, and WebSocket communication.

classes.name: SAPEventCallback
classes.description: A callback interface for handling SAP events, providing a virtual method onSAPEvent that can be overridden.

classes.name: AudioPlayer
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing audio playback, including pipeline control, volume, source configuration, and WebSocket communications.

methods.name: AudioPlayer
methods.description: Constructor for initializing an AudioPlayer instance with specified audio type, source type, playback mode, and object identifier.

methods.name: ~AudioPlayer
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up resources used by the AudioPlayer.

methods.name: Play
methods.description: Starts playback of the specified URL.

methods.name: PlayBuffer
methods.description: Plays audio data from a buffer.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes playback if paused.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses current playback.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops current playback.

methods.name: SetMixerLevels
methods.description: Sets the primary and player volume levels.

methods.name: SetSmartVolControl
methods.description: Enables or disables smart volume control with parameters for threshold, detection time, hold time, and duck percentage.

methods.name: getAudioType
methods.description: Returns the current audio type.

methods.name: getPlayMode
methods.description: Returns the current play mode.

methods.name: getSourceType
methods.description: Returns the current source type.

methods.name: push_data
methods.description: Pushes raw audio data into the pipeline.

methods.name: wsConnectionStatus
methods.description: Updates WebSocket connection status.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming GstMessages, likely for state changes or errors.

methods.name: PushDataAppSrc
methods.description: Callback function to push data into app source element.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the static environment with a callback.

methods.name: DeInit
methods.description: Cleans up the static environment.

methods.name: waitForMainLoop
methods.description: Blocks until the main loop is complete or stopped.

methods.name: GstBusCallback
methods.description: Static callback for GTK bus messages.

methods.name: event_loop
methods.description: Runs the main event loop for GStreamer.

methods.name: getObjectIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the object identifier.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the current media URL.

methods.name: isPlaying
methods.description: Returns whether playback is active.

methods.name: configPCMCaps
methods.description: Configures PCM audio capabilities.

methods.name: configWsSecParams
methods.description: Configures WebSocket security parameters.
